changes.comment: Removed the unused group-creation/member-invite transport API (`FeishuTransport.createGroup`/`.inviteMembers` and their `FeishuCreateGroupInput`/`FeishuCreateGroupResult`/`FeishuInviteMembersInput`/`FeishuInviteMembersResult` types), the dead `FEISHU_TRANSPORT_PACKAGE` marker constant, and the `webSocketRegistration` test/embedding seam on `FeishuTransportOptions` (and its `FeishuWebSocketRegistration` type) — no production caller in this repo used any of them.
